For teachers and tutors

About Parts of the Body

Body vocabulary with clear drawings: head, eye, ear, nose, mouth, tooth, tongue, neck, shoulder, arm, elbow, wrist, hand, finger, thumb, chest, stomach, back, hip, leg, knee, ankle, foot and toe. These are the words for telling a doctor where it hurts.

How to play

  1. Listen to the word.
  2. Type it, or tap the picture.
  3. Check it.

Play it as a class

Choose Parts of the Body in the Teacher Game, then practise "My ... hurts."
